name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; no Ghidra address residue. Accurately describes the role: a thin battle-spell wrapper that drives status-effect (cure-family) application plus the projectile animation pass. Caller fd2_cast_spell_14_dispatch_aa8 passes spell_id 0x14, the cure worker @ 0x22AF6 does the actual per-target work; the generic 'apply_status_effect_with_anim' fits the wrapper role.
purpose: Thin battle-spell dispatch wrapper: reset the AoE/fx counter, deduct caster MP, delegate per-target status-effect application+animation to fd2_cast_status_cure_spell, then tail-call the projectile-paths animation when any target was affected.
logic_summary: 17-instruction wrapper (CHK(0x18) stack probe + body 0x22AA8..0x22AF5). Sets data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx = 0; calls fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster_idx, status_spell_id); calls fd2_cast_status_cure_spell(caster_idx, status_spell_id, target_count, p_target_array, status_byte_offset) which applies the status cure to each target and sets the AoE count; if that count != 0, tail-jumps (JNZ 0x1DF58) to fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths, else RET. The large per-target animation loop shown in Ghidra's pseudocode belongs to the inlined worker, not this function's body. Sole caller fd2_cast_spell_14_dispatch_aa8 @ 0x22A85 (CALL @ 0x22A9F) passes spell_id=0x14, status_byte_offset=0x25 (poison status byte); sibling fd2_cast_spell_15_dispatch_aa8 reaches it via the shared tail with 0x15/0x26.
signature: void fd2_apply_status_effect_with_anim(int caster_idx, int status_spell_id, int target_count, int p_target_array, int status_byte_offset)

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Caster unit id; forwarded to fd2_deduct_caster_mp and the cure worker. Caller passes caster_unit_id.
params.reason: Accurate, no address residue, not a generic param_N.

params.name: status_spell_id
params.semantics: Spell id (caller passes literal 0x14); used as the MP-deduct spell id and forwarded to the worker as spell_id.

params.name: target_count
params.semantics: Number of selected targets (n_targets); forwarded to the worker.

params.name: p_target_array
params.semantics: Pointer (as int) to the byte array of target unit ids; forwarded verbatim to the worker. Caller passes target_id_array.
params.reason: Accurate; p_ prefix correctly denotes a pointer carried as int.

params.name: status_byte_offset
params.semantics: Raw runtime_char struct byte offset of the status flag the worker tests/clears (caller passes 0x25 = poison status byte; sibling path uses 0x26 = sleep). Forwarded to the worker as sprite_id.
params.reason: Accurate; matches the worker's documented status-byte addressing.

returns.semantics: No return value. Control either RETs after the cure worker (no targets affected) or tail-jumps into fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths (which RETs for the caller).
